clarity.notes: Single status source (one pill, pulse when live); exception-based pills; humanized events with raw type demoted to mono microtext; zero raw enums as primary text.

hierarchy.notes: One accent primary action per state from the plan's state machine; now-strip leads Overview; 320px rail stays quiet; 3 tabs with foreground underline per Tabs contract (not accent).

typography.notes: Verbatim token scale: H1 1.4rem/600/-.028em (compact 1.1rem on run page), body 13.5, section labels 10.5 uppercase, mono strictly for ids/event types/durations with tabular numerals.

motion.notes: State-conveying only per product register: live pulse, ticking elapsed, 200ms sheet slide; all guarded by prefers-reduced-motion; no page-load choreography.

brand.notes: Token block copied verbatim from agent-detail.html (packages/ui lineage); accent budget held (primary CTA + sanctioned live-state tints); flat depth, no side-stripes, no gradients; canonical RuntimeSelector geometry with 7-bar meter reused, not rebuilt.

checks.plan_acceptance: Tabs 7→3; pills ≤3 default; destructive verbs in overflow; operator tier (lease/heartbeat/claim-hash/seq/bridges/stream) only inside Inspect drawer; no set-status control (status is derived); no delete-run verb; nullable result renders em-dash placeholder; CLI hints use `agh task` singular.
checks.structure: style 1/1, script 1/1, sections balanced in all three files (grep-verified).
checks.states: in_progress (task-detail.html) · blocked+approval, failed, needs_attention, completed (task-detail-states.html) · running, failed (task-run-detail.html).
checks.visual_capture: Skipped: the render/screenshot helper is blocked in this environment (known limitation); validation relies on the preview pane.
